entities.summary: Abdelrahman Salah Orabi Abdelgawwad is an Egyptian boxer. A continental silver medalist at the 2015 African Games, he competed in the light heavyweight event at the 2016 Summer Olympics. He also competed in the men's light heavyweight event at the 2020 Summer Olympics.
